name: Content Modification Log
description: This module implements an exportable, date filterable log that tracks content modifications.
project_description: This module implements an exportable, date filterable log that tracks content modifications. It displays information about the modified entity, the user performing the modification, and a timestamp of when the modification was made. Only node and file entity saves and deletions are recorded, into a dedicated content_modification_log database table, and shown on an admin report at /admin/reports/content-modification-log with date-range filtering and a CSV export.
